Question B-001-019-001.

Why the correct answer is right: Below 148 MHz, amateur station frequency stability must be equivalent to crystal control.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "It shall remain within 2 parts per million, one hour after power up": A 2-parts-per-million value after warm-up is not the stipulation in the official answer.
- sourceIndex 2: "It must not drift more than 10 Hz from a governmental time signal broadcast service": Drift relative to a governmental time-signal broadcast is not the amateur stability rule tested here.
- sourceIndex 3: "It shall remain within 0.05% from -30 to +40 degrees Celsius ambient temperature": A 0.05 percent temperature specification is not the bank's frequency-stability requirement.
